waistWidth.label: Waist width
waistWidth.help: Across the top of the waistband, laid flat (half the waist all the way round).

waistbandHeight.label: Waistband height
waistbandHeight.help: Height of the band at the top. 0 = no separate band.

rise.label: Rise
rise.help: From the top of the waist down to the crotch. Low-rise is shorter, high-rise longer.

thighWidth.label: Thigh width
thighWidth.help: Width of one leg at the crotch, as drawn from the front.

kneeWidth.label: Knee width
kneeWidth.help: Width of one leg about halfway down (mid-leg on shorts).

legOpening.label: Leg opening
legOpening.help: Width of one leg at the hem, laid flat.

inseam.label: Leg length (inseam)
inseam.help: From the crotch down the inside of the leg to the hem. Short values make shorts.

legSplay.label: Leg angle
legSplay.help: Moves the bottom of each leg outwards (+) or inwards (−): flares, wide stances, tapers.
